title: The Underground River
text: A black river runs through the caverns, fast and cold and loud, roaring off into the dark. A boat tied at the bank rocks on the current. It has been tied here a long time, and the rope is fraying.

options.label: Take the old boat, trusting the rope held for a reason.

outcomes.text: It carries you fast and far, out into the light.
It goes over a fall in the dark, breaking to pieces around you.

options.label: The toughest swims ahead with a rope, so the rest can cross safely.

outcomes.text: The crossing is safe, though the one who swam it is battered by the rocks.

options.label: Walk the bank, keeping clear of the roaring water.
